name: NeuroContent
author: NIA

sections.description:
NeuroContent PRO is a powerful AI content generator for WordPress designed to help you create, schedule, approve, and publish SEO-optimized articles automatically.

Powered by OpenAI, the plugin generates high-quality content and AI images directly inside WordPress — without switching tools or copy/paste workflows.

From idea to publication in minutes.

🚀 What NeuroContent PRO Can Do

✓ Generate Complete SEO Articles in Seconds
Create long-form blog posts, affiliate content, product descriptions, news articles, and more using customizable prompts.

✓ Create AI Images Inside WordPress
Generate unique featured images, thumbnails, and illustrations automatically from text prompts.

✓ Automate Publishing with Smart Triggers
Schedule automatic article generation:
– Hourly
– Daily
– Weekly
– Custom intervals

Perfect for content scaling and niche websites.

✓ NEW – Email Article Approval & Control

Review generated articles directly from your email inbox.

You can:
– ✅ Approve article
– ❌ Delete article

No need to log into WordPress.
One click from your email and the action is executed instantly.

Perfect for agencies and editorial workflows.

✓ NEW – Facebook Auto Posting (Social Share)

Connect your Facebook account and automatically publish or schedule posts to your Facebook Pages.

Social Share features:
– Publish instantly when article goes live
– Schedule Facebook posts
– Select specific Facebook Pages
– Control posting directly from the Gutenberg / Classic Editor meta box
– Grow traffic automatically while publishing content.

✓ Native WordPress Integration

  • Works with Gutenberg & Classic Editor
  • Works with any theme or page builder
  • No coding required
  • Built for performance

🎯 Built For

  • Bloggers
  • SEO professionals
  • Affiliate marketers
  • Agencies
  • News publishers
  • E-commerce stores
  • Automated content websites

If you need scalable content production inside WordPress — NeuroContent PRO is your publishing engine.

🔧 Core Features

⭐ AI Article Generator

  • Long-form SEO articles
  • Custom tone & structure
  • Keyword control
  • Heading structure (H1–H3 optimized)

⭐ AI Image Generator

  • Generate featured images from prompts
  • Unique visuals per article
  • Direct WordPress media integration

⭐ Automated Content Scheduling (Triggers)

  • Fully automated article creation
  • Recurring publishing intervals
  • Hands-free content production

⭐ Email-Based Article Approval (NEW)

  • Approve or delete generated articles via email
  • One-click secure action links
  • Ideal for editorial review workflows

⭐ Facebook Social Share Automation (NEW)

  • Connect Facebook account
  • Post automatically to Facebook Pages
  • Schedule social posts
  • Configure per article inside editor
  • Boost organic reach automatically

⭐ Editor Meta Box Control

  • Generate content with one click
  • Control AI settings per post
  • Publish or schedule social sharing
  • Works inside Gutenberg and Classic Editor

🧠 Why Choose NeuroContent PRO?

  • All-in-one AI content automation
  • SEO-friendly article generation
  • Automated publishing workflows
  • Social media automation included
  • Saves hours of manual work
  • Scales content production affordably

NeuroContent PRO is not just an AI writer.
It’s a complete WordPress automation system.

👉 Upgrade to NeuroContent PRO to unlock advanced editorial approval workflows and full automation control.

External Services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API (api.openai.com) to generate text and images based on your prompts.

🔹 What service is used?

OpenAI API – https://api.openai.com
Used for:
– Text generation (articles, titles, summaries)
– Image generation

🔹 What data is sent and when?

Data is sent only when you click a “Generate” button or manually trigger AI creation.
The plugin sends:

  • Your text prompt
  • Optional content you choose to include (titles, descriptions)
  • Selected model and generation options
  • No personal user data is sent automatically

No background requests are made without user action.

🔹 Legal information

OpenAI Terms of Use
https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

OpenAI Privacy Policy
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

OpenAI may receive standard HTTP metadata (e.g. IP address) according to their policy.

No automatic posting without user configuration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin in Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Open NeuroContent AI in your WordPress Dashboard
  4. Add your OpenAI API key
  5. Start generating articles and images instantly
sections.faq:
What do I need?

An OpenAI API key. Optional: Facebook account for Social Share.

Can I approve articles by email?

Yes. When enabled, you can approve or delete generated articles directly from your email inbox.

Does it automatically post to Facebook?

Yes. After connecting your account, you can publish or schedule posts to your Facebook Pages.

Is content unique?

Yes. Each AI generation request produces unique output.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes. Full integration via dedicated meta box.

Does it work with Classic Editor?

Yes. Automatically supported.

  • New PRO Feature: Social Share integration for automatic Facebook posting.

1.0.4

  • Improved prompt handling and sanitization for maximum stability and data integrity.
  • Enhanced support for long, multi-line AI prompts with consistent line endings.
  • Prevented accidental loss of trigger prompts when saving settings.
  • Optimized internal data handling to ensure reliable storage of complex prompt content.
  • General hardening of settings logic for improved reliability in advanced configurations.

1.0.3

  • New PRO Feature: One-Click Article Approval via secure email notifications.

1.0.2

  • New Feature: You can pick ChatGPT model

1.0.1

  • Compatibility with WordPress 6.9

1.0.0

  • First public release
